title: Failure probability for polynomial separation
statement: Let $n,\ell,m\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $M$ be the number of subsets of $[n]$ of size at most $\ell$. If $\delta\in\mathbb{R}$ satisfies $2^M\exp\!\left(-m(1/2)^\ell\right)\le\delta$, then for $m$ independent uniform samples from $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, the probability that evaluation on the samples fails to distinguish some two distinct degree-at-most-$\ell$ polynomials over $\mathbb{F}_2$ is at most $\delta$.
hypotheses_covered: $2^M\exp(-m(1/2)^\ell)\le\delta$, where $M$ counts subsets of $[n]$ of size at most $\ell$
